description: Simulator runtimes and Xcode components (needs Xcode: build from an image with Recipes/xcode)

platforms.description: simulator runtimes, separated by spaces: iOS, watchOS, tvOS or visionOS, each optionally @version (iOS@26.5) for an older one; about 8 GB each; empty for none

components.description: Xcode components, separated by spaces (MetalToolchain compiles .metal shaders, about 840 MB); empty for none

steps.name: Simulator runtimes
steps.run: for platform in $AGENT_VM_PARAM_PLATFORMS; do case "$platform" in *@*) xcodebuild -downloadPlatform "${platform%@*}" -buildVersion "${platform#*@}" || exit 1;; *) xcodebuild -downloadPlatform "$platform" || exit 1;; esac; done

steps.name: Prepare the runtimes' shared caches, so each box's first simulator starts sooner
steps.run: if [ -n "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_PLATFORMS" ]; then xcrun simctl runtime dyld_shared_cache update --all; fi

steps.name: Components
steps.run: for component in $AGENT_VM_PARAM_COMPONENTS; do xcodebuild -downloadComponent "$component" || exit 1; done

checks: echo "$(xcrun simctl runtime list | grep -c '(Ready)') simulator runtimes ready"

for component in $AGENT_VM_PARAM_COMPONENTS; do xcodebuild -showComponent "$component" | grep -q 'Status: installed' || { echo "$component is not installed"; exit 1; }; done; echo "components: ${AGENT_VM_PARAM_COMPONENTS:-none}"
